license_evidence: Appendix A.1 of 10.18653/v1/2024.findings-acl.318 states that OpenExp will be released under CC-BY-SA and that distribution and sharing require the same license.
split_note: OpenExp.tar contains the unsplit 274,439-record list. The paper describes a random 8:1:1 split, but the released processing code calls random.shuffle without a fixed seed. SynRXN therefore provides a clearly labeled deterministic transformation-group split.
